name: Agishan Thaya
description: Agishan Thaya: data analyst, then data scientist, then operations researcher. Now an engineer at Shopify on Order Editing.
lead: Hi, I'm Agishan, currently a SWE at Shopify.
bio: The thread through all of it is data: warehouse models, dbt pipelines, experiments, and the dashboards people actually open. I like owning the whole path, from raw tables to the number someone makes a decision with.

Before this: analytics at Loblaw and Maple Leaf Foods, data science at RBC and Dandy, operations research at Cambridge Memorial Hospital, and engineering at Shopify (infrastructure) and Claim Health AI.
I graduated from the University of Waterloo in 2026 with a degree in Management Engineering, a double specialization in Artificial Intelligence & Computing, and a spot on the Dean's Honours List.
reachOut: Reach out if you want to talk scheduling problems, streaming systems, or what to cook this week.
